hits.preview: Dear Suzuki san, From our side, the past alignment was that IML would provide ISZE with the APL together with a recommendation list per specific model upon request. (see VL27 example as per attached). Based on this input, ISZE would then further validate and complement the proposal by comparing demand from previous models (e.g. via FIG-KEY analysis), and adjust quantities where needed. In addition, the recommendation list should clearly highlight new parts. For reference, from IMIT we have consistently received both an overall proposal and a customer-level breakdown. If the expectation is that ISZE should now perform this exercise completely independently, could you please also share the official procedure used at IML? This would help us ensure alignment and work according to a consistent and uniform guideline. Thank you in advance for your support. Kind regards, Bart Bart Van den Bosch
